column1: # WPAD HLE hook addresses: Crash of the Titans -> Crash: Mind over Mutant.
# These are the guest functions that nWiiRuntime/src/hle/ios.cpp HLEs to provide
# Wii Remote input, plus the entry set nWiiRecomp/src/recompiler.cpp classifies
# as native_wpad_entry. The CotT values in patches/nwii-native-runtime.patch are
# meaningless in MoM, so they are re-keyed to these.
#   * nine pairs come from tools/analysis/crossmatch.py (shape-identical, same
#     size): they all share the shift +0xB897C, i.e. the WPAD block is the same
#     object laid out contiguously in both games;
#   * 0x803EC730 is four bytes larger in MoM (176 -> 180), which moves the rest
#   * every address below lands on a function start in MoM's Ghidra index whose
#     first instruction word is identical to CotT's, and every size matches
# columns: cott_addr  mom_addr  cott_size  mom_size  shift  evidence
